caption: NAHB HMI (top, with the 50-neutral line) and SPY price (bottom) through the Global Financial Crisis window (2007-01 to 2009-12), with registry event markers. HMI hit its record low of 8 in Jan-2009 — the deepest builder pessimism ever recorded — near the equity trough, not ahead of the peak. Shaded bands mark NBER recessions.
